data.name: 敵国工場への潜入
data.detailed_description:
This game is a 3D third-person shooter centered on intense indoor combat.

Controls are simple: use W, A, S, and D to move, the SPACE bar to jump, and click to attack.

Players take on the role of a special forces operative and infiltrate a key enemy base—where cutting-edge weapons are being manufactured—alone. The goal is to defeat countless enemies and destroy the massive weapon awaiting you at the very heart of the facility.

・Use the minimap to search for enemies within the vast factory. Strategic thinking is required to identify enemy positions.

・We’ve implemented spectacular sparks and explosion effects to deliver the exhilarating thrill unique to shooting games.

・Boss battles are highlighted by massive HP bars and raging flames. The final scene puts the player’s skills to the test.

・Simple controls and early enemy detection via the minimap make the game easy for anyone to play.

・The inclusion of a time attack mode ensures that even experienced players will keep coming back to aim for the fastest time.

data.short_description: このゲームは3D三人称視点シューティングゲーム（TPS）です。 操作方法はシンプルで、W・A・S・Dキーで移動、スペースキーでジャンプ、クリックで攻撃します。 シンプルな操作性とミニマップのおかげで手軽に遊べつつ、タイムアタック形式によって繰り返し楽しめるゲームを目指しました。

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Windows audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Windows audio device
